title: Principal Solutions Architect - Quantum-Safe Networks
description:
About IonQ :

IonQ , Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: This position is US-based and can work onsite or hybrid from one of our offices or fully remote.
Travel: Up to 30%, domestic and international
Job ID: 1779
The Role:
We are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to design how networks become quantum-safe - for the largest network operators, enterprises, and government agencies in the world.
Today's networks are secured with cryptography that a cryptographically relevant quantum computer will break. Every operator and enterprise will have to inventory their cryptography, make it agile, migrate to post-quantum algorithms, and in the highest-assurance segments complement that with quantum-safe key distribution. Almost nobody knows yet what that architecture actually looks like. That is the problem you will solve - first with customers, on real networks, and then as reusable architectures that shape what IonQ builds.
This role sits deliberately in two places. About half your time is customer-facing: in collaboration with our GTM colleagues, you’ll be leading architecture discussions, designing quantum-safe target architectures and migration paths, running proofs of concept and interoperability tests, and supporting complex pursuits as the technical authority. The other half is design authority, standards work, and providing thought leadership internally and externally: turning what you learn in the field into reference architectures, migration playbooks, standards, whitepapers, blogs, and product requirements that our engineering and product teams build against.
You are equally comfortable in a firewall design review as you are in a discussion about hybrid key exchange and crypto-agility. You can explain to a CISO why their crypto inventory is the hard part, and to a network engineer exactly which IPsec algorithms to use and where they could insert external key material in order to become quantum-safe.
This is not a software architecture role - you will not own a codebase (it’s a plus if you can do some scripting). It is an architecture and customer role: you own designs, decisions, and the technical credibility of IonQ 's quantum-safe networking story.
Responsibilities :

• Design quantum-safe target architectures and migration paths for customer networks - spanning WAN and transport, data center and campus, segmentation and access control, key management, and the crypto that underpins all of it.

• Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with network, security, and infrastructure teams. Assess the current state, identify where cryptography is embedded and where it is brittle, and build a migration plan the customer can actually execute.

• Own the technical thread in complex pursuits: architecture proposals, RFI/RFP responses, security and compliance questions, competitive positioning, and objection handling - in partnership with Sales.

Optexity is a product-driven research lab building clinical reasoning and computer use models on data no other lab can reach. That gives us proprietary clinical reasoning trajectories from practicing physicians, and a feedback loop between real patient encounters, our models, and the products built on top of them.

- Customer obsession - we start with the customer and work backwards

- Write up findings as technical reports and papers

- Has real research experience - can define a problem, not just execute a known one

- Has trained models before (not just fine-tuned APIs) and is fluent in Python

- Bachelor's in computer science and related fields.

- Energized by open-ended problems and ambiguity

- Wants to publish, not just ship

- Takes ownership without needing to be guided

- Genuinely wants a startup over big tech - speed and ambiguity as defaults, not exceptions

Nice to have

- Prior founder or founding-engineer experience

- Strong product taste

- Worked on healthcare datasets before

- Built LLM-powered products before

- Ambitions to start your own company someday - we'll support that path

What you get
